title: System compositor word, level domain and canonical finite transports
statement:
Let $u$ be a universe, $C_n$ commutative rings in universe $u+1$, and $\tau_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$ arbitrary ring maps. For schemes in universe $u$, use the simultaneous derived system categories $\mathcal D_X$, open extension $J_j$, total derived direct image $R_q$, and system evaluation $E_n$ of [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations]; their canonical compositors $sComp$, $jComp$ of [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons]; and the proper/open mate $\gamma$ of [def-coef-semilinear-proper-open-mate]. For maps $j:X\hookrightarrow V$, $b:V\hookrightarrow\overline X$, $q:V\to Y$, $p:\overline X\to\overline Y$, $i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$, $s:\overline Y\to Z$, require that $j,b,i$ are open immersions, $b,i$ are quasi-compact, $q,p$ are proper, and fix $p\circ b=i\circ q$. Define compatibleCompositorWord to be the actual natural transformation
$$(J_jR_q)(J_iR_s)\longrightarrow J_{b\circ j}R_{s\circ p}$$
obtained by applying $\gamma_{b,q,p,i}$ between the $J_j$ and $R_s$ factors, then $sComp_{p,s}$, then $jComp_{j,b}$, with the canonical functor associators. Composition in this displayed functor notation is in execution order. No Cartesian condition, properness of $s$, or invertibility assertion is imposed for this word.

Define compositorLevel at $X,n$ as $E_{n,X}$ followed by level-zero evaluation of the constant strict tower [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. Define compositorLevelJ and compositorLevelR by composing the prescribed system-evaluation comparisons [def-pur-semilinear-evaluation-comparisons, def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations] and constant-tower evaluation comparisons [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension, def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations] for open extension and direct image, respectively, and compositorSupportEvaluation by their composite for $J_jR_q$ with associators. For proper $q$ and open $j$, a finite discrete commutative ring $\Lambda$ in universe $u+1$, a ring map $\varphi:C_n\to\Lambda$, an object $L\in D^e_\Lambda(X)$ in the bounded-below etale coordinates [def-pur-finite-site-tower-etale-coordinates], $M\in\mathcal D_X$, and an isomorphism $e:H_XL\simeq\operatorname{compositorLevel}_{X,n}M$, where $H$ is the canonical scalar etale-origin functor [def-cbc-finite-constant-coefficient-transport], define compositorSupportTransport to be
$$H_Y(P^e_qJ^e_jL)\xrightarrow{hR_q}R_q^{\rm const}H_VJ^e_jL\xrightarrow{R_q^{\rm const}(hJ_j)}R_q^{\rm const}J_j^{\rm const}H_XL\xrightarrow{(J_j^{\rm const}R_q^{\rm const})(e)}(J_j^{\rm const}R_q^{\rm const})(\operatorname{compositorLevel}_{X,n}M)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{compositorSupportEvaluation}^{-1}}\operatorname{compositorLevel}_{Y,n}(J_jR_qM).$$
Here $hR,hJ$ are exactly the normalized proper and open finite-scalar comparisons of that definition node; the displayed execution order agrees with the functor word. For open $j,i$ and proper $q,s$, and a supplied scalar etale-origin witness $w$ for the level of $M$, define compositorFiniteSource by applying this transport first along $(j,q)$ with $w$ and then along $(i,s)$ with the resulting isomorphism, keeping the same $\Lambda,\varphi$. For open $j,b$ and proper $p,s$, define compositorFiniteTarget by applying the same transport along $(b\circ j,s\circ p)$ with that same witness.

For a finite commutative ring $A$ in universe $u$ and $K\in D(\mathcal T_X(\operatorname{ULift} A))$, define compositorBoundedConstructible to mean that every cohomology sheaf, after the canonical fixed-module presentation restriction [def-pur-proetale-module-scalar-restriction], is constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], and that there exist integers $a\le b$ such that its cohomology is zero outside $[a,b]$. Finally, for a prime $\ell$ and finite $E_0/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], specialize $C_n,\tau_n$ to the actual lifted positive coefficient quotients and quotient maps of [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. For $M\in\mathcal D_X$, define compatibleCompositorDomain to mean that compositorBoundedConstructible holds for $\operatorname{compositorLevel}_{X,n}M$ with $A=\mathcal O_{E_0}/\mathfrak m_{E_0}^{n+1}$ for every $n\in\mathbb N$. Each level has its own interval; there is no uniform bound, normalization, Tor-amplitude condition, or theorem about the compositor in this definition.

lean.statement:
def compatibleCompositorWord {X V XB Y YB Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ V) (b : V ⟶ XB) (q : V ⟶ Y) (p : XB ⟶ YB)
    (i : Y ⟶ YB) (s : YB ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    [QuasiCompact b] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper q] [IsProper p]
    (h : b ≫ p = q ≫ i) :
    (J C τ j ⋙ R C τ q) ⋙ (J C τ i ⋙ R C τ s) ⟶
      J C τ (j ≫ b) ⋙ R C τ (p ≫ s)
